thread.title: Steel Ball Run: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken • Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure - Episode 3 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters enjoyed the unusual race-focused premise and felt it distinguished this part from earlier JoJo installments.
The episode’s action was widely praised for being creative, intense, and cinematically staged.
Several commenters liked the inventive powers and found the newly introduced character abilities promising.
Some viewers thought the production quality and handling of the main confrontation were stronger than in the first two episodes.
The graphic injury imagery impressed some viewers but made others uncomfortable.
The ending and unchanged outro drew both anticipation and mild disappointment.
A few comments questioned the internal consistency of characters recovering from severe injuries.
